title: Adaptive Skill Granularity for Coding Agents: Runtime Routing and Macro-to-Micro Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.31461v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reusable skills allow large language model agents to package task-specific procedures, tool affordances, and execution guidance into modular units. Prior work has largely studied how agents retrieve, compose, or synthesize skills before execution. In coding agents, however, execution poses an additional runtime control problem: the same task may be solved through primitive tool calls, macro skills, or hybrid execution that starts with a macro and falls back to micro-level recovery. We introduce Adaptive Skill Granularity, a framework that treats skill granularity as an action-abstraction policy conditioned on task structure, execution state, and macro-skill failures. The system combines a feature-based granularity controller and a finite-state recovery executor. translated_title: 编码代理的自适应技能粒度：运行时路由与宏到微恢复
translated_abstract: 可复用技能使大语言模型代理能够将任务特定的流程、工具可供性和执行指导打包为模块化单元。先前的工作大多研究代理在执行前如何检索、组合或合成技能。然而，在编码代理中，执行带来了一个额外的运行时控制问题：同一任务可以通过原始工具调用、宏技能、或以宏技能开始并在失败时回退到微级恢复的混合执行方式来解决。我们提出了自适应技能粒度（Adaptive Skill Granularity）框架，该框架将技能粒度视为一种以任务结构、执行状态和宏技能失败为条件的动作抽象策略。该系统结合了基于特征的粒度控制器和有限状态恢复执行器。我们使用一种确定性的编码代理协议评估该框架，采用验证器定义的成功率、总成本以及宏技能采纳率、失败恢复等过程指标进行衡量。
tldr: 该论文提出自适应技能粒度框架，将技能粒度作为基于任务结构、执行状态和宏技能失败条件的动作抽象策略，通过粒度控制器与有限状态恢复执行器在运行时动态路由宏技能或微级工具调用，并在宏技能失败时实现宏到微的自动恢复，从而提升编码代理的成功率与成本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Adaptive Skill Granularity, a framework that treats skill granularity as an action-abstraction policy conditioned on task structure, execution state, and macro-skill failures, combining a feature-based granularity controller with a finite-state recovery executor to enable runtime routing and macro-to-micro recovery for coding agents.
